value.rationale: The exact universal side mark gives a concrete counterintuitive spatial effect when parts are unbalanced, with independence from initial configuration, meeting time, pair identity and number of walkers. The k+1-state exact Laplace classification compresses a large particle state space and yields a fixed-k rare-collision exponential law, all natural for encounter-driven systems.
